peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the k value in PVP?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Povidone (polyvinylpyrrolidone, PVP) is available in different grades, described by the K-value – a parameter that is derived from the. [1] relative viscosity of an aqueous povidone solution. Increasing K-values go along with a growing adhesive strength of the polymer.
